title: Upgrade self-hosted runners to GitHub Actions runner >= v2.329.0
body: The self-hosted runners used by self-hosted-smoke.yml (labels: 'local' for macOS, 'docker' for Linux) must be running GitHub Actions runner software >= v2.329.0 before this PR can safely merge. The new runner version check step added to self-hosted-smoke.yml will fail the job with a clear error if an outdated runner is detected, but the runner software itself must be upgraded on the machine. Download the latest runner from https://github.com/actions/runner/releases.
rationale: actions/checkout@v6 requires runner >= v2.329.0 for credential persistence features. The version check step added here gates the checkout action but cannot upgrade the runner software itself.
